common.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist or you no longer have access to it.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the token printed when your hub started, or one created in your account settings.
login.tokenHint: Tokens are shown once. The first admin token is printed in the hub log and saved to <data>/admin-token.
login.network: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
login.rateLimitedLong: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.
login.configError: Could not load the hub configuration.
login.noMethods: No sign-in method is enabled on this hub.
login.invited: You have been invited to this hub.
login.invite_invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
login.invite_used: This invitation has already been used.
login.subtitleEmail: Sign in with the email linked to your account, or with an access token.
login.subtitleEmailOnly: Sign in with the email linked to your account.
login.emailHint: Link your email in Account settings first. Only a linked email can be used to sign in.
login.emailSent: If this email is linked to an account, a code has been sent. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
login.codeResendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s

banner.superseded: This browser is connected in another tab. Only one tab can hold the connection.
banner.revoked: This browser was removed from your devices. Pair again to continue.
banner.version: The hub does not support this version of the web app. Reload to update.
banner.quota: Your account has reached its connection limit.
banner.nodeOffline: This node is offline. New messages stay on this device until it is back.
banner.notifications: Notifications are not enabled in this browser.
banner.update: A new version of the web app is ready.
banner.storage: This browser could not save data locally (storage full or blocked). Unsent messages and cached sessions may be lost when you close this tab.
banner.enrollMany: {{count}} devices want to join your nodes.

sidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
sidebar.signOutHint: Keeps this browser’s device key and cached sessions on this computer.
sidebar.signOutRemove: Sign out and remove this device
sidebar.signOutRemoveHint: Revokes this browser and deletes its keys and cached data. Use it on shared computers.
sidebar.signOutFailed: Could not sign out: {{error}}. You are still signed in.
sidebar.signedOutKept: Signed out. This browser still keeps its device key and cached sessions. On a shared computer, use “Sign out and remove this device”.
sidebar.scanApprove: Scan to approve a new device

setup.installBody: The daemon runs on the machine that has your coding agents. Run these commands there.
setup.doneBody: Your node is paired. Open it to create a project and start a session.
setup.installSourceHint: no prebuilt binary for this platform, build from source (needs Rust)
setup.passwordBody: With a node password you can unlock this node from any device, even when none of your paired devices is at hand. It is optional, and you can set it later in the node settings.
setup.notifyBody: Anycon can tell you when a session needs your approval, hits an error or finishes, even when this tab is closed. It is optional, and you can change it later in Settings → Notifications.

pair.title: Pair a node
pair.subtitle: Enter the code shown by anycon pair on the machine you want to control.
pair.codeHint: 8 characters, e.g. 7K3P-Q2MX (16 characters for a link or QR code). Dashes and case do not matter.

errors.retry: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again.
errors.invalid_code: A pairing code has 8 or 16 letters and digits.
errors.not_found: That code does not exist or has expired. Run anycon pair again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.quota: Your account has reached its device limit.
errors.forbidden: That node belongs to a different account.
errors.hub_unavailable: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection.
errors.no_identity: The hub did not accept this browser as a device.
errors.timeout: The node did not answer in time. Check that its daemon is running.
errors.peer_gone: The node disconnected during pairing. Try again.
errors.handshake_failed: The secure handshake failed. Check the code and try again.
errors.ack_invalid: The node could not prove its identity, so nothing was saved. Run anycon pair again and make sure you are using the right hub.
errors.key_changed: This node’s key has changed. Remove it in settings first, then pair again.

link.warning: You opened a pairing link. Pairing adds that node to your account and lets this browser control it. Only continue if you started pairing yourself, on your own machine.

node.noProjectsHint: Create a project, clone a repository or open an existing folder, or just send a message to start a temporary session.
node.cachedHint: Showing cached data while the node is offline
node.unknownBody: This node is not paired with this browser, or it was revoked.
node.versionBody: The node speaks protocol {{daemon}} but this web app speaks {{web}}. Update the daemon or reload the page.
node.noiseFailedTitle: This node no longer recognizes this device
node.noiseFailedBody: It may have been reinstalled, or this browser was revoked. Unlock it again with your account, or pair again with a short code.
node.projectsOffline: The project list is not available while the node is offline.

project.name: Name
project.trashBody: The folder moves to the node's trash. You can restore it from node settings.
project.noSessionsHint: Use “New session” to start the first one.
project.linkedHint: A linked project lives in its own folder on the node, outside the workspace.
project.missingBody: {{path}} no longer exists or cannot be read, so new sessions are turned off. Restore the folder, or remove this project from the list.
project.removeBody: This only removes the project from anycon. The folder and the files in it are not deleted.
project.removeSessions: Existing sessions stay in your history. If you link this same folder again they can continue; if this name later points to a different folder, the old sessions cannot continue.
project.nameExists: A project with this name already exists.
project.nameInvalid: A project name cannot be empty, contain “/”, “\” or control characters, or start with a dot.
project.nameTooLong: That name is too long (255 bytes at most).

linkErrors.forbidden: This node does not allow linking that folder. It must be inside the allowed folders (workspace.link_roots), must not be hidden (unless it is listed there explicitly) or a system or credentials folder, and cannot contain or sit inside anycon’s own workspace or data folders.
linkErrors.exists: That name is already used by another project, or this folder is already linked. Pick a different name.
linkErrors.invalid: That folder cannot be linked. It may already be part of the workspace, or the name is not valid.

removeErrors.busy: This project has running sessions. Wait for them to finish or stop them, then try again.
removeErrors.invalid: Only linked projects can be removed from the list.

project.nameCase: Another project is named “{{name}}”. On a case-insensitive filesystem (the default on macOS and Windows) the node counts that as the same name and will refuse it.
project.nameCaseClash: Another project is named “{{name}}”. Names that differ only in case count as the same name on this node.

folderPicker.label: Choose a folder
folderPicker.cannotLinkHint: This folder cannot be linked: it is a project already, or it contains or sits inside the workspace or anycon’s data folder. You can still open it.
folderPicker.truncated: Only the first 1000 folders are shown. Type a path to go further.
folderPicker.unavailableTitle: Opening existing folders is turned off on this node
folderPicker.unavailableBody: The node’s workspace.link_roots setting is empty (or none of its folders exist), so no existing folder can be linked. Add a folder to link_roots in the node’s config file, for example link_roots = ["~"], then reopen this dialog.

errors.forbidden: That folder is not open to this browser: it is outside the folders this node allows (workspace.link_roots), or it is a system or credentials folder.
errors.invalid: That path is not a folder this node can open.
errors.protected_sensitive: “{{name}}” cannot be opened because it is a protected system or credentials folder.
errors.protected_data_dir: “{{name}}” cannot be opened because it is anycon’s own data folder.

blocked.hidden: Hidden folder: it can only be linked if it is listed explicitly in workspace.link_roots.
blocked.sensitive: System or credentials folder, or one that contains them: it cannot be linked.
blocked.workspace: Inside the anycon workspace, or containing it: it cannot be linked.
blocked.data_dir: anycon’s data folder, or inside or containing it: it cannot be linked.
blocked.filesystem_root: The filesystem root cannot be linked.

session.promoteBody: The temporary workspace becomes a project folder with this name.
session.backgroundTasks_one: {{count}} background task is still running — the agent will pick up its result
session.backgroundTasks_other: {{count}} background tasks are still running — the agent will pick up their results
session.goneBody: It may have been deleted from another device.
session.agentMissing: The agent “{{agent}}” is not available on this node.

message.queued: Will be sent after this turn ends
message.attachmentExpired: An attachment is no longer on the node. Edit the message and add the images again.
message.attachmentLost_one: {{count}} image could not be restored. Add it again.
message.attachmentLost_other: {{count}} images could not be restored. Add them again.
message.attachmentInUse: These images already belong to another session (for example one that was just created while the connection dropped). Edit the message and add the images again.
message.attachmentsTooLarge: The images on this message add up to more than the node accepts. Edit the message and remove some.

tool.truncatedHint: The node keeps the beginning and the end of a very large output and drops the middle.
tool.liveTruncatedHint: Streaming stopped after the live output limit; the final result still has the beginning and the end.

system.agentTurn: Background task finished — the agent continued

permission.notePlaceholder: Optional note for the agent (used with options that accept one)
permission.modeChange: The agent asks to switch to mode “{{mode}}”.
permission.alreadyResolved: Another device already answered this request.
permission.dangerousWarning: “{{mode}}” is a dangerous mode: the agent will run commands and edit files without asking you again. Only allow it if you really mean to.
permission.expired: Expired — the node will close this request.
permission.contentUnknown: The patch contents could not be shown, so you cannot see what it changes. Be careful before approving.
permission.deniedFolderChanged: This request was denied because the project folder changed, and the turn was stopped.
permission.requestGone: This request no longer exists, so it can’t be answered.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholderProject: What should the agent do in {{project}}?
composer.placeholderScratch: Describe a task to start a temporary session…
composer.queueNotice: Will be sent after this turn ends.
composer.offlineNew: The node is offline. You can write a message but cannot start a session yet.
composer.attachOffline: The node is offline. Images can't be attached right now.
composer.attachMax_one: You can attach up to {{count}} image to one message.
composer.attachMax_other: You can attach up to {{count}} images to one message.
composer.attachNotImage: Only images can be attached. Skipped {{name}}.
composer.attachTooLarge: {{name}} is still too large after shrinking it.
composer.attachUnsupported: This agent doesn't accept any of the image formats the app can send.
composer.attachTotal: Skipped {{name}}: the images on one message can add up to {{size}} at most.
composer.attachmentsUnsupported: The selected agent doesn't accept images, so the images you added won't be sent.
composer.attachUploading: Wait for the images to finish uploading.
composer.attachFailedBlock: Retry or remove the images that failed to upload first.

errors.tooLarge: The image is larger than this node accepts.
errors.corrupt: The image was damaged on the way. Try again.
errors.busy: The node is busy receiving other uploads. Try again in a moment.
errors.quota: The node is holding too many images that haven't been sent yet. Send or remove some, or try again later.
errors.diskFull: The node's disk is almost full, so it can't take more images right now.
errors.finalizing: The node is already finishing this upload. Try again.
errors.expired: The upload expired on the node. Try again.

options.customModelHint: Any model id the agent accepts. Used ids are remembered on this browser.
options.thinkingAdjusted: Thinking level adjusted to {{value}} for this model.
options.dangerBody: In this mode the agent can act without asking you.
options.dangerHint: The session header will show this mode in red while it is active.
options.dangerForbidden: Not allowed by this node's settings
options.queuedChange: Change will apply when this turn ends.
options.dangerousDefaultSkipped: The default permission mode “{{mode}}” is dangerous, so it was not preselected. Choose it yourself if you really want it.

info.title: Session info
info.archiveBusy: Stop the session or answer its pending request first, then archive it.
info.deleteBody: This removes its history from the node. The agent's own session files are not touched.

agent.noneReady: No agent is ready on this node.
agent.noneDetected: No agents detected on this node.

nodeSettings.agentsHint: Agents found on the node. Defaults here apply to new sessions from every device.
nodeSettings.defaultsHint: Stored on the node and shared by all your devices.
nodeSettings.addDeviceBody: On the new device open the pairing page and enter this code, or scan the QR code.
nodeSettings.limitsBody: Limits are read-only for now. Change them in the node's config.toml:
nodeSettings.limitIdle: Idle timeout before the agent process exits
nodeSettings.limitDangerous: Whether dangerous permission modes are allowed
nodeSettings.limitsLater: Editing limits from the web comes in a later version.
nodeSettings.longCodeHint: Safer when you pair through a hub you do not run. Turn it off for a short code that is easier to type.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeBody: Make a one-time code. A new device that signs in to the same account can use it to join this node.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeHow: On the new device, sign in to the same account, pick this node and choose “I have an access code”.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeDisabled: Approving new devices is turned off for this node. Turn it on in the Access tab.

devices.revokeBody: The device loses access immediately and has to pair again.
devices.revokeSelf: This is the browser you are using. You will have to pair it again.
devices.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the device: {{error}}. It may still be able to connect — try again.
devices.revokedOffline: {{count}} node(s) were offline and still hold this device’s key. The hub no longer routes to it; remove it from their device list once they are back.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.tokensHint: Tokens sign you in from a new browser. Each token is shown once when you create it.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy it now. You will not be able to see it again.
settings.lastMethod: The last sign-in method cannot be removed.
settings.sessionsHint: Browsers currently signed in to your account.
settings.devicesHint: Every device on your account, grouped by the node it is paired with.
settings.emailIntro: Link an email to sign in with a one-time code on any device and to get alerts by email.
settings.emailSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
settings.emailResendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
settings.emailLinked: Email linked. You can now sign in with it on any device.
settings.emailUnlinkBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with this email, and email alerts stop.
settings.emailLastMethod: This is your only sign-in method, so the email cannot be unlinked. Create an access token first.

appearance.blockZoomHintIos: Tapping a text box no longer zooms the page in. Pinch and double-tap zoom are blocked too.
appearance.blockZoomHintAndroid: Blocks pinch and double-tap zoom. Android's "Force enable zoom" accessibility setting still overrides this.
appearance.thinkingHint: How the agent's reasoning is shown.
appearance.enterHint: Automatic sends on desktop and inserts a new line on touch devices.

admin.title: Admin
admin.forbiddenBody: Your account cannot manage this hub.
admin.invitesHint: An invitation link lets one person create an account on this hub.
admin.inviteOnce: Copy the link now. For security it is only shown once.

errors.nodeOffline: The node is offline. Nothing was sent.
errors.timeout: The node did not answer in time.

rpc.invalid_settings: The agent does not accept those options.
rpc.agent_unavailable: The agent is not available on the node.
rpc.node_busy: The node is at its session limit. Try again shortly.
rpc.busy: The agent is busy with a turn. Try again when it finishes.
rpc.forbidden: The node does not allow this.
rpc.unsupported: This agent does not support that.
rpc.protocol_mismatch: The node uses an incompatible protocol version.
rpc.internal: Something went wrong on the node.

api.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
api.csrf: The request was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
api.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
api.email_taken: This email is already linked to another account.
api.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired.
api.last_login_method: That is your only sign-in method, so it cannot be removed.
api.push_endpoint_not_allowed: The hub does not support this browser’s push service.
api.device_not_found: The hub does not know this browser as a device. Pair or unlock a node first.
api.subscription_not_found: The hub has no push subscription for this browser. Turn push off and on again.

errors.tooLarge: That is too large to send in one request.

dropped.too_large: The hub refused a message because it was too large. This is a bug in the web app - please report it.
dropped.not_paired: The hub says this browser is no longer paired with {{node}}. Pair it again.

errors.syncFailed: Could not fully sync with the node: {{error}}. What you see may be out of date.

agentError.agent_reconnecting: Connection to the model dropped — reconnecting…
agentError.unsupported_request: The agent asked for something anycon does not support yet, so the request was declined.
agentError.context_window_exceeded: The conversation no longer fits in the model’s context window. Start a new session, or send something shorter.
agentError.sandbox_error: The sandbox stopped or failed a command. Check the session’s permission mode; a less restrictive one may be needed.
agentError.policy_violation: The provider’s usage policy stopped this request. Rephrase it or change the task.
agentError.rate_limited: The agent hit a rate or usage limit. Wait a while and try again.
agentError.auth_failed: The agent is not signed in, or its credentials were rejected. Check its status in the node settings.
agentError.agent_context_reset: Earlier messages in this conversation are no longer visible to the agent — it started a fresh thread.

markdown.imageHint: Remote images can leak information to their host, so they only load when you click - and the hub’s security policy may block them anyway.
markdown.openImage: This image is from an external site and the hub’s security policy does not load it. Open it from {{host}}

removeDevice.title: Sign out and remove this device
removeDevice.body: This revokes this browser on every node that is online right now, signs you out, and deletes the device key, token and cached sessions stored in this browser. Nodes that are offline keep this browser’s key until you remove it from their device list, but the hub will no longer route to it.
removeDevice.errorHub: The hub did not revoke this device: {{error}}. Nothing was deleted. Try again, or remove the local data anyway (the device will stay registered on the hub until you revoke it from another browser).
removeDevice.errorLogout: Signing out failed: {{error}}. Nothing was deleted.
removeDevice.reportSkipped: {{count}} node(s) were offline, so they still hold this browser’s key. The hub no longer routes to it; remove it from their device list when they are back.
removeDevice.errorNodes: These nodes could not revoke this browser: {{nodes}}. Nothing else was changed and nothing was deleted, so you can try again when they are online. If you remove the local data anyway, those nodes keep this browser’s key until you remove it from their device list.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: This ends your session with the hub, but this browser keeps its device key, token and cached sessions on this computer: signing in again here is the same device, and anyone who can open this browser’s developer tools could still use them. Push notifications for this browser are turned off (turn them on again in notification settings after you sign back in). On a shared or borrowed computer, remove the device instead.

shortcut.reviewFirst: That request was off screen. Check it, then press the shortcut again.

workspace.label: Work in
workspace.branchInvalid: That is not a valid git branch name.
workspace.branchReserved: main, master and HEAD can’t be used as the new branch name.
workspace.notReady: Worktrees need the project folder to be the root of a git repository with at least one commit.
workspace.readingBlocked: Waiting for the project’s git info before creating the session…

worktree.title: Worktrees
worktree.hint: Worktrees anycon created for sessions, including ones kept after archiving and ones whose session was deleted.
worktree.removeBody: The worktree folder inside project {{project}} is deleted from the node.
worktree.discardHint: Uncommitted changes exist nowhere else and can’t be recovered.
worktree.archiveBody: This session works in a worktree on branch {{branch}}. Choose what happens to the worktree.

dispose.label: What to do with the worktree
dispose.autoHint: Deletes the worktree if it has no uncommitted changes (the branch is kept if it has commits of its own). Keeps it otherwise.
dispose.keepHint: The folder and the branch stay. Delete them later in node settings.
dispose.removeHint: The folder is deleted. The branch stays unless you delete it too.
dispose.branchKept: The branch stays while the worktree is kept.
dispose.commitsLost_one: {{count}} commit on this branch would be lost
dispose.commitsLost_other: {{count}} commits on this branch would be lost
dispose.autoKeeps_one: {{count}} uncommitted change, so it will be kept.
dispose.autoKeeps_other: {{count}} uncommitted changes, so it will be kept.

preview.stopBody: This disconnects the preview of this port on all your devices. Pages open elsewhere stop loading. You can start it again at any time.
preview.stoppedBody: The preview of port {{port}} was closed on every device.
preview.emptyBody: When the agent starts a dev server, its port shows up here. You can also pick “Other port…” and enter one yourself.
preview.detectionUnavailable: This machine can’t detect listening ports, so only ports listed in preview.allow_ports can be previewed.
preview.offline: The node is offline. Ports and new previews are unavailable until it is back.

errors.port_not_allowed: This port isn’t allowed for preview. By default only servers started by this session are. To preview another port, add it to preview.allow_ports in the node’s config.toml.
errors.disabled: Preview is turned off on this node (preview.enabled in config.toml).
errors.unauthorized: The hub doesn’t accept this browser as a paired device. Sign in again or pair this browser with the node.

local.no_device_token: This browser has no device token for the hub yet. Pair it with a node first.
local.no_node_key: This browser doesn’t have the node’s key. Pair it with the node again.
local.bad_template: The hub’s preview address is not valid.
local.bad_label: The node returned a preview name the hub can’t use.

hub.preview_disabled: This hub has preview turned off.
hub.invalid_label: The node returned a preview name the hub can’t use.
hub.label_taken: This preview address is already used by another node on this hub.
hub.too_many_labels: This node already has the maximum number of preview addresses on this hub.
hub.not_found: The hub doesn’t know this node, or this browser isn’t paired with it.

list.title: Open previews
list.hint: Preview tickets issued by this node’s devices and still valid. Closing one revokes every ticket of that port and disconnects it.

policy.title: Which ports can be previewed
policy.default: By default a preview can only reach servers started by the session itself: the listening process runs under the session’s agent, or was started in its working folder.
policy.allowPorts: To allow other ports, list them in preview.allow_ports in the node’s config.toml. Set preview.enabled = false to turn previews off for the whole node. The node only ever connects to 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

git.stale: Could not refresh. Showing the last known state.
git.syncRunning: Wait until the agent finishes its turn.
git.messageQueued: Queued. It will be sent after this turn.
git.messageUnsent: The node is offline. The message is saved and will be sent when it is back.

error.no_pr: No pull request for this branch yet.
error.gh_not_installed: Can’t look up the pull request: gh is not installed on the node.
error.gh_not_authenticated: Can’t look up the pull request: gh is not signed in on the node.
error.no_remote: Can’t look up the pull request: the repository has no remote.
error.error: Could not look up the pull request.

errors.not_worktree_ready: This project can’t have worktrees: its folder is not the repository root, or it has no commits yet.
errors.bad_base: That base does not exist in the repository.
errors.uncommitted_changes: There are uncommitted changes. Commit or discard them first.
errors.merge_in_progress: A merge is already in progress. Let the agent resolve it, or abandon it.
errors.merge_in_progress_hint: The status will update in a moment.
errors.fetch_failed: Fetching the base from the remote failed.
errors.git_failed: git could not merge the base.
errors.not_git: This session is not in a git repository.
errors.archived: The session is archived. Unarchive it first.
errors.unarchive_failed: Could not restore the session’s worktree, so it stays archived.
errors.branchExists: That branch already exists. Pick another name, or leave it empty.
errors.busy: The agent is busy with a turn. Try again when it finishes.
errors.generic: Could not read the git status.
errors.worktree_creating: The worktree is still being created.
errors.worktree_failed: The worktree could not be created.
errors.not_worktree: Only a session in its own worktree can do that.
errors.worktree_not_active: The worktree is not in use.
errors.no_merge_in_progress: There is no merge in progress.
errors.no_commits: This repository has no commits yet.

messages.commit: Commit the current changes to branch {{branch}}. Write a commit message that summarizes what changed.
messages.pr: Push branch {{branch}} to the remote and open a pull request against {{base}} with gh pr create. Write a clear title and description.
messages.prDefault: Push branch {{branch}} to the remote and open a pull request with gh pr create against the repository’s default branch. Write a clear title and description.
messages.resolve: Merging {{base}} into {{branch}} hit conflicts. Resolve the files that `git status` lists as conflicted and finish the merge commit.

event.worktree_created_files_one: Started in worktree {{branch}} (based on {{base}}, copied {{count}} file)
event.worktree_created_files_other: Started in worktree {{branch}} (based on {{base}}, copied {{count}} files)
event.worktree_kept: Worktree {{branch}} has uncommitted changes, so it was kept
event.worktree_missing: The folder of worktree {{branch}} is gone

tab.creating: The worktree is being created. Its changes will show up here once it is ready.
tab.missing: The worktree folder is gone. If it was only deleted, your next message rebuilds it from the branch. If something else took its place, move that away, or archive or delete the session.
tab.failed: The worktree could not be created, so there is nothing to compare.
tab.removed: The worktree was deleted when the session was archived. Unarchive the session to rebuild it from branch {{branch}}.

git.archivedNoAsk: Unarchive the session to send messages to the agent.

push.testBody: Push notifications work on this browser.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose how Anycon reaches you when a session needs you and you are not looking at it.

push.title: Push on this browser
push.hint: A system notification, even when Anycon is closed.
push.enabled: Push is on for this browser.
push.disabled: Push is off for this browser.
push.testSent: Test push sent. It should arrive in a moment.
push.testGone: The push service no longer knows this browser. Turn push off and on again.
push.testError: The push service did not accept the test push.
push.testErrorStatus: The push service did not accept the test push (it answered HTTP {{status}}).
push.noDevice: Pair or unlock a node in this browser first. Push is tied to this browser’s device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser’s site settings, then reload this page.
push.unavailable: This hub has no push keys, so it cannot send push notifications.

unsupported.insecure: Push needs a secure connection. Open Anycon through its https address.
unsupported.no_service_worker: This browser has no service worker, which push needs.
unsupported.no_push: This browser does not support web push.
unsupported.ios_install: On iPhone and iPad, push only works for apps on the Home Screen. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Anycon from there.

errors.dismissed: Permission was not granted, so push stays off.
errors.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser’s site settings.
errors.no_registration: The service worker is not ready. Reload the page and try again.
errors.subscribe_failed: The browser could not subscribe to its push service. Check your network and browser settings.
errors.unsubscribe_failed: The browser could not cancel its push subscription.

categories.title: What to notify
categories.hint: Push goes to browsers that have it turned on and are not open. Email is only sent when none of your devices is online.

label.enroll_requested: A device asks to join a node

categories.emailNoSmtp: This hub is not set up to send email.
categories.emailNoAddress: Link an email address in Account settings to get alerts by email.
categories.loadFailed: Could not load your notification settings.

others.title: Other browsers with push
others.empty: No other browsers have push turned on.

security.passwordFailures: The node password of {{node}} was entered wrongly {{count}} times in a row.
security.passwordLocked: Password unlock of {{node}} is now locked.
security.passwordChanged: The node password of {{node}} was changed by {{who}}.
security.passwordCleared: The node password of {{node}} was removed by {{who}}.
security.settingsChanged: The access settings of {{node}} were changed by {{who}}.

scan.title: Scan to approve a new device
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code shown on the new device.
scan.notAnycon: That is not an anycon enrollment QR code.
scan.unpaired: This browser is not paired with the node {{node}}, so it cannot approve.
scan.offline: The node cannot be reached right now. Try again when it is online.
scan.onlyIfInFront: Only approve if this QR code is on the screen of the device right in front of you.
scan.missing: This request is no longer there. It may have expired: ask the new device for a fresh QR code.
scan.notScan: This QR code belongs to a different kind of request, not a scan request. It cannot be approved here. Ask the new device to start again.
scan.notWaiting: This request is not waiting to be approved right now. It may already be handled, or the new device is not ready. Ask the new device for a fresh QR code.
scan.done: Approved. The new device will finish by itself.
scan.taken: Another device already handled this request.
scan.gone: This request has expired or was cancelled.
scan.deniedHelp: Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings and try again. Or let the new device use “Approve on a paired device” instead.
scan.unavailable: The camera could not be started on this device.

approve.title: A device wants to join {{node}}
approve.unverified: reported by the device, not verified
approve.onlyThisOne: Only approve the device right in front of you.
approve.ifNotYou: If you did not just start this on another device, tap Deny.
approve.scanOnly: This device asked to be approved by scanning its QR code. Use “Scan to approve a new device”, or deny it.
approve.codeIntro: Type this code on the new device to finish joining {{node}}.
approve.codeWarning: Do not tell it to anyone. anycon will never ask you for it.
approve.taken: Another device already handled this request.

enrollTab.intro: Decide how new devices can join this node. Devices that are already paired are not affected by anything here.
enrollTab.loadFailed: Could not read the access settings from the node.
enrollTab.passwordUnset: No password yet. Set one to unlock this node from any device, even without a paired device at hand.
enrollTab.passwordHint: A new device can unlock this node by typing the password. The node checks it itself and limits wrong guesses; the hub never sees it.
enrollTab.backoff: Too many wrong attempts. The next try is allowed in {{time}}.
enrollTab.lockedBody: Password unlock is locked after 10 wrong attempts in a row. Run anycon passwd --enable on the node, or turn it back on here.
enrollTab.reenableBody: 10 wrong attempts in a row may mean someone is guessing. Only continue if you typed it wrong yourself. If you are not sure, change the password first.
enrollTab.setBody: Anyone who knows this password can add a device to this node if they are signed in to your account. The node never stores the password itself.
enrollTab.passwordRule: At least {{count}} characters. There are no other rules: the node limits wrong guesses itself.
enrollTab.clearBody: Devices that are already paired keep working. New devices will have to use a paired device to join.
enrollTab.approvalLabel: Allow approving from a paired device
enrollTab.approvalHint: Lets new devices join by QR scan or with an access code. Turn it off to allow only the node password.
enrollTab.activityFailed: Could not read the node’s activity log.

unlock.title: Unlock {{node}}
unlock.subtitle: This browser is not paired with this node yet. Pick a way to prove it is you:
unlock.offline: Unlocking needs the node to be online. This page continues by itself when it comes back.
unlock.notYours: This node is not on your account, or it was removed.
unlock.loadFailed: Could not load your devices from the hub.
unlock.usePairCode: Use a short pairing code instead

approve.title: Approve on a paired device
approve.hint: A paired device is at hand, but you do not want to scan

scan.how: On your phone, open anycon and choose “Scan to approve a new device” in the account menu.
scan.paused: The QR code was withdrawn when this page went to the background, so it does not hold a spot on the node.
scan.qrLabel: QR code for approving this browser

approve.intro: We send a request to your paired devices. Approve it on one of them, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
approve.waiting: Request sent. Approve it on a paired device, then type the 6-digit code it shows here.

code.intro: On a paired device open the node’s settings, then Devices, Add device, Access code. Or run anycon pair --enroll on the node.
code.label: 6-digit code

password.intro: Type the node password you set for this node.
password.label: Node password
password.hint: On a borrowed computer, do not let the browser save it. anycon never stores your password.

steps.waitingScan: Waiting for a paired device to scan

list.title: Unlock a node
list.subtitle: These nodes are on your account, but this browser is not paired with them yet.

errors.codeExhausted: This code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired or has been used up. Request a new one.
errors.wrongScan: The approval did not match. Start over to get a new QR code.
errors.backoff: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
errors.locked: Password unlock for this node is locked after 10 wrong attempts in a row. Run this on the node itself, or turn it back on from a paired device (node settings, Access):
errors.method_disabled: This node does not allow this way of unlocking. Try another one.
errors.password_not_set: This node has no password. Pick another way, or set one from a paired device.
errors.no_code: This node has no valid access code right now. Make one with “Add device” on a paired device.
errors.offline: The node is offline. Unlocking needs it to be online.
errors.busy: This node is handling too many enrollments right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.quota: Your account has reached today’s limit for adding devices.
errors.forbidden: This browser is not allowed to unlock that node.
errors.not_found: That node is not on your account.
errors.hub_unavailable: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection.
errors.hub_no_reply: No answer from the hub. You may be sending requests too often. Wait a little and try again.
errors.handshake_failed: The secure handshake failed. Start over.
errors.no_identity: The hub did not accept this browser as a device.
errors.ack_invalid: The node could not prove its identity, so nothing was saved. Make sure you are using the right hub.
errors.key_changed: This node’s key has changed. Forget it here first, then unlock again.
errors.invalid: The node did not accept that request.
